<!-- pr-reviewer: af01d3d9e09f3167d7964560fc78fc8b7a1f00f5 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Scope of this review (per the maintainer): the merge resolution and #349's own change, with targeted tests only.

**What looks good**
- Merge: `git diff origin/main...af01d3d --stat` lists exactly #349's 12 files. Only `crates/ui/src/lib.rs` conflicted, and it keeps both `pub mod path_lines;` and main's `pub mod post_file;`. Nothing from main was dropped. `interact.rs` still has main's `axis_note::triad_notes` overlay (line 838) and the only diff against main is the move loop moving into `path_lines::cache_lines` plus `push_line` becoming `pub(crate)`.
- Warned-move marking is view state only (colour, marker, `frame_at` camera move). No project data is touched, so no command is needed.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `path_lines.rs` or `warned_moves.rs`. Out-of-range warning indices are ignored, not indexed.
- Provenance lines are present on both new modules. The decision file `docs/decisions/261-warned-moves.md` is present. The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Refs #261`, and CHANGELOG.md is not edited.
- No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts or dependency changes.

**Local results (merged tree, own worktree)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test warned_moves` | 2 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib warned_moves` | 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- path_lines banner warned operations toolpath_lines op_page axis_note` (CWD crates/ui) | 26 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` is 1748 lines (pre-existing debt); this PR shrinks it by about 40 lines.
- Whole suites and snapshot lanes were not run, by request.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
